Coram : R. SUBHASH REDDY*, SANJIV KHANNA
Karnataka Agricultural Produce Marketing (Regulation and Development) Act, 1966: s.65 – Respondent purchased spices from outside the State of Karnataka and after importing, sold the processed goods within the market areas of of market fee on the respondent – Correctness of – Held: A harmonious reading of s.65(2) of the Act, its second proviso, and explanation to the same and clause (2-A)(ia), makes it clear that if any dealer imports agricultural produce from outside the State into any market area
